start.text: Oda brings the Mercy in under the cliff to a quay of black dressed stone, where a flight of steps goes down into the water and iron rings are let into the face. Nobody takes her lines. A deckhand jumps for it and makes them fast himself, and stands there afterwards holding the rope as if he'd expected someone to thank him.
Fog all round: thin on the quay, thick everywhere past it, thicker than you've seen it anywhere on the ring. It stands at the foot of the cliff like water held back by a wall that isn't there.
This is where they came from. The boats. Straight down this water, past my bow, the week it went dark.

Someone is sitting on an iron bollard at the head of the steps, in a Keeper's robe gone silver from the hem to the waist, coiling a rope in his lap. The other end of the rope runs off over the edge of the quay and down into the water, and isn't tied to anything. He's humming.
